name: learnflow-database
description: MCP server providing real-time access to LearnFlow database for AI agents
author: LearnFlow Team

tools.name: get_student_progress
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive student progress data including mastery scores, completion rates, and learning patterns

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.description: List all available exercises with filters for topic, difficulty, and completion status

topic.description: Filter by Python topic (e.g., loops, functions, classes)

limit.description: Maximum number of exercises to return

tools.name: get_code_submissions
tools.description: Retrieve student's code submissions with review feedback and scores

tools.name: get_conversation_history
tools.description: Retrieve conversation history between student and AI agents for context continuity

tools.name: detect_struggles
tools.description: Identify learning struggles based on error patterns, failed attempts, and performance metrics

tools.name: search_code_patterns
tools.description: Search for common code patterns across all student submissions to identify learning trends

pattern.description: Code pattern to search (e.g., 'for loop', 'function definition')
